caption:
💻 Switch to degree mode

✅ Step 1: Open the wrench (graph settings).
✅ Step 2: Switch from radians to degrees.
✅ Step 3: Now sin(30) = 0.5 like it should.
✅ When to use it: Default is radians. This costs people trig points.

Save this for test day 🔖
